proposal.reason: Primary change is in network/proxy behavior: communicator-scoped NET/CollNet backend selection (`config.netName`), NET plugin lifecycle per communicator, larger NET request/pool limits, and proxy op-pool/progress SHM handling and batching. `device-topology` is additionally needed because intra-node path logic now compares GPU-vs-NIC bandwidth/affinity (`ncclTopoCheckNet`) and introduces `PATH_NET` topology semantics. `transport` is also substantive because P2P/SHM/NET connect eligibility and connection-type selection are changed to follow the new topology/network decisions.
